descriptionChirho: Sinful pride, insolence, or haughty self-exaltation condemned as contrary to God's will; used of nations, kings, and the wicked whose overweening presumption invites divine judgment.
Exalted greatness, splendor, or majestic dignity attributed to God or bestowed by God upon a person or entity; a positive quality denoting legitimate, divinely grounded grandeur.
